rationale: Solo and small-team website operators suffering real, ongoing infrastructure cost from AI scrapers are a clear and reachable buyer — the anti-bot market (Cloudflare, DataDome) demonstrates this segment absolutely pays, and the pain is daily and financial. The core problem with this as a factory opportunity is buildability: a credible bot-detection and mitigation product requires infrastructure-level access (CDN/reverse proxy, traffic analysis, rate-limit enforcement) that cannot be assembled from Claude prompts and a Stripe link. Operational autonomy is also limited because each site's traffic pattern and scraper behavior differs, demanding per-customer tuning. Validate whether a narrow deliverable — e.g. a diagnostic report or an AI-crawler policy configuration guide — can command payment before investing further.
solution_plan: The full vision (an always-on anti-scraper shield) is not buildable solo without infrastructure. However, a narrower productized service IS possible: a one-time 'AI Scraper Cost Audit' — the operator submits their server logs or a Cloudflare analytics export via a form, Claude analyzes the traffic patterns, identifies the top offending bot user-agents and IPs, and returns a plain-English report with specific robots.txt and rate-limit config recommendations they can implement in Cloudflare for free. Build: intake form (Typeform or similar) + Claude analysis prompt + automated PDF/email report delivery + Stripe link at ~$49-99 one-time. Sell: reach operators via webmaster communities (HN, r/webdev, IndieHackers) with a free sample analysis; outreach goes out only after operator approves. Maintain: fully automated — form submission triggers Claude, report emails automatically. The only human step is approving outreach batches. Caveat: this is a one-time purchase, not recurring SaaS, so validate that enough buyers exist before building.
notes: buildability_with_ai (4) fails the 6-floor build_gate; operational_autonomy (4) fails the 7-floor build_gate. Stage capped at validate. Narrowing to a report/audit product could raise both scores significantly on re-score.
